claims.claim: Li's Dec30 warning contained a seven-case SARS identification, alongside later within-day coronavirus subtyping clarification
claims.limitations: The virus was not SARS-CoV; the infection warning concerned a real emerging pneumonia cluster. Do not label all content fully true or false.

claims.claim: Wuhan police publicly said eight unnamed people had been handled for spreading unverified pneumonia information
claims.limitations: Eight identities and all their messages not individually authenticated from Jan1 notice.

claims.limitations: Does not extinguish Li's actual written reprimand.

claims.claim: Supervisory commission March19 identified improper reprimand and procedural defects
claims.limitations: Official finding not independent judicial verdict on all original messages.

claims.claim: Police March19 withdrew Li's reprimand and apologized to his family
claims.limitations: This is a concrete correction record. Earliest presently located dated syndication is Sina 20:55, not original Weibo publication.

claims.claim: Two responsible police officers received administrative demerit and warning respectively
claims.limitations: Officer sanctions do not mean Li was punished with these sanctions.

claims.claim: An authored court-affiliated commentary advocated tolerance of inaccurate but low-harm warnings
claims.limitations: Not a judgment, binding interpretation or institutional ruling of the Supreme People's Court.

claims.claim: In March 19 Q&A, National Supervisory Commission official said Li had no subjective intention to disrupt public order in sending his December warning
claims.limitations: Distinguish official determination of intent from independently established psychological state; not a blanket judgment on all eight unnamed people.

claims.claim: January 1 police used unlawfulness/rumor enforcement language; January 29 police described the eight as minimally serious education-and-criticism cases
claims.limitations: This is a public-language comparison about unnamed eight, NOT a judicial finding or proof that every one was formally punished.

claims.claim: Li publicly discussed his Jan3 written admonition before Mar19 and said he was not detained, fined or given a statutory warning
claims.limitations: Do not confuse interview statements with independent confirmation of every police case fact; the published picture contains some personal identifiers and should not be copied into public UI.

claims.claim: The Jan1 eight-person bulletin did not publicly list names; Jan31 reports differ in assuming or questioning whether Li was among those eight
claims.limitations: One interview uses phrasing that presupposes membership; Li separately says he is unsure. Avoid definitive identity matching.

claims.claim: Two Jan31 Li interviews report different emphases: general report of little lasting impact versus acknowledged fear of detention and workplace retaliation

interview_frame_comparisons.event: Li's answers concerning the impact of the January 3 admonition

interview_1.question_topic: general effects on family and everyday life of the admonition
interview_1.short_excerpt: 没有给我带来特别的影响

interview_2.question_topic: whether he feared detention and repercussions at work
interview_2.short_excerpt: 我也怕被拘留；当时担心单位会秋后算账

interview_frame_comparisons.interpretation: Responses foreground different aspects of possible risk. Reporting time and question framing differ; statements are not a reliable longitudinal measurement of a psychological state and need not be logically inconsistent.
limits: They are two reports of interviews with the same person, not independent population samples.
No causal estimate of censorship or chilling effect can be derived.
Article publication time is not necessarily interview time; both sources refer to Jan30 interview contact.
Avoid distributing the underlying medical/family details or unredacted admonition photograph.

unresolved_questions: Did the public one-Jan 'eight' roster include Li? Historical sources connect the broader event, but the first bulletin is unnamed; no categorical mapping asserted.
Independent original copies/hashes of Li's entire Dec30 chat stream, image and 11s CT video are not in this package; March19 commission is retrospective report.

The first source located here discussing Li's personal reprimand is a Jan31 11:29 interview, followed by a 19:35 syndicated interview with an interviewee-provided photograph. Earlier independent publication cannot be excluded.
Extent of any chilling effect on healthcare warnings requires independent empirical evidence, not only a single outcome.
March19 commission scope and motives should not be inferred solely from the text; this package evaluates public documents and decisions.
The strongest initial '依法查处' public characterization and later '仅教育、批评' are two official public texts; causal reasons for the difference are not established by textual comparison alone.

Earliest verified dissemination of the Commission conclusion in this package is the 19:14 shortened report; an earlier press/agency release may exist. Distinguish first found summary from authorized full transcript.

The published reprimand photograph is attributed to Li by reporters; source archive holds no independently authenticated original physical document scan, and no identifying document fields should be copied into this site's public data.

19:04 CLS is the earliest publicly readable source found in this register for the Commission conclusion, not verified as the Commission's original first release or an authenticated full-document publication.
Two published Jan31 interview phrasings about fear and effects have distinct question wording; avoid a false binary contradiction, inferred motive, or a general self-censorship prevalence claim.

Sina withdrawal repost has displayed 2020-03-19 20:55 time, earlier than 21:47; first original police Weibo publication timestamp and authenticated initial article edition are not independently located.

Municipal archive LW01 shows 2020-01-01 11:36 although archive URL path dates Apr 2020; contemporaneous accounts describe original police Weibo post as Jan 1 afternoon. Do not backdate police public label to 11:36 absent contemporaneous first edition.

methodological_limits: 最早可取得的是媒体转述的网传说法，不是认证过的原始发布帖；3月22日23:21的报道时间不能替代网传首次发布时间。
原始社交媒体账号、原帖及编辑历史未获独立认证。
资料的公开发布日期不等于所有人实际获知该信息的时刻。
正式政策变化不能自动归因于此前辟谣或行政执法。
对政策真伪、发言责任及执法比例性的评价需要不同证据，不作单一总分。
警方同期通报包含至少两种不同的封控预测（七天、四天）；仅凭官方或媒体概括不能证明它们出自同一传播者或属于同一条原帖。
4月1日公布的7天/14天分类管控，以及4月4日继续封控，都是早期辟谣之后新增的官方措施；不能把政策后续变化当作3月22日传播内容在当时已具真实来源的证明。
4月4日晚官方公告通过新华社和4月5日人民日报刊发，同一消息具有决策日、转发日和承载页面日期；as-of状态使用最早核实公开时间，注明转发链。
刑法构成要件审计是对公开证据充分性的研究，不是法律意见、无罪判断或针对具体个人的定罪评议。
Y先生是媒体报道中的匿名转发受访者，现有来源未证明其为警方立案通报的两人之一；两种材料绝不可合并进行个体指认。
单次匿名采访只能证明当时有记录的风险感知与表达调整自述，不能直接证明强制性自我审查的普遍性、警方威慑效应或后续行为变化的因果机制。
2022-03-23 14:02匿名转发者采访的公开时间早于本研究已知18:10警方立案通报新闻。不能把该受访者3月22日晚的担忧归因于3月23日晚警方立案通报。
政策公告的3月31日晚首发时间(S10)与4月1日发布会解释(S06)必须分别显示；不得把政策存在延长控制的最早可知日误写为4月1日。
3月26日现存官方实录与媒体报道不同，不能在缺失历史网页版本或发布会完整音视频时断言发生过政治审查或事后删改。
3月23日17:59:14是本轮找到的较早警方通报新闻发布时间，不保证是所有传播平台的首发时间。
央视新闻客户端的2022年3月26日同期采编报道亦记录吴凡的封城可行性回答，但与其他记者报道仍属于同一场活动，不应将来源数量作为独立政策决策次数。
第一财经、文汇报的视频栏目页面已核查到标题与文字描述，但未独立查看/校验完整视频媒体字节；不得声称原始发布会无剪辑录像已取得。
2020四部门疫情司法指导明确区分恶意编造和轻信低危传播，但不能以Y先生的采访推定警方调查的两名对象也属于轻信转发。
